text: The normal biopsy result is puzzling given the mass, so I need to rule out a vascular cause for your swelling. Do you have any pain or tenderness in your calves, and have you noticed any shortness of breath or chest pain? REQUEST TEST: D-Dimer

speaker: Doctor
text: A normal D-dimer makes pulmonary embolism unlikely, so I need to evaluate for heart failure or other systemic causes of your swelling. Have you experienced any orthopnea, paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea, or palpitations? REQUEST TEST: Echocardiogram

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal echocardiogram rules out heart failure, so your leg swelling is likely due to venous compression from the mass or a paraneoplastic syndrome.
